title: Stoke Space reusability
description: A feature section: a neon-barred label beside an extra-wide all-caps heading, a full-width 7:3 image, then a 4:5 image next to a hairline list of rows. Rows rest at 30% ink, come to full ink on hover, and a thin plus slides each one open (turning to a minus).
notes: needs JavaScript for opening rows; rows render closed (or the defaultOpen one) without it
media slots: a wide 7:3 image and a tall 4:5 image, both cropped like object-cover
